up: For compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614531, retrieve the exact activity values. For each activity record, return the ChEMBL ID of the compound, the standard activity type, the standard relation (e.g., '=' or '>'), the standard value, and the standard units.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614531'
